title: Community backlash and social services visit

tellings.quote: And the social services came to my house trying to remove me from the house.
I I I caught so much problem from the community in 2007 when this happened. Half my family, twothirds of my family I quit speaking to my own cousins and family
tellings.difference: Stresses that he fell out with half to two-thirds of his own family, including cousins, and does not mention the social services visit.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Chris being ostracized by his community after the 2007 events in North Carolina.

as_told.title: Chris's family turns on him after the 2007 events

plain: A North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he attracts UFOs, says that after his experience in 2007 his community turned against him. He tells Michels it caused him so much trouble that he stopped speaking to half or even two-thirds of his own family, cousins included. In another telling he says social services came to his house and tried to have him removed from it. Bledsoe tells it from his own life, to show what speaking up about what he saw cost him.
